english: I am your eye doctor.
target: 眼科医です。
romanisation: gan-ka-ee dess

english: Please sit here.
target: ここに座ってください。
romanisation: koh-koh nee soo-wat-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Does it hurt? Point to where.
target: 痛みますか？どこか指さしてください。
romanisation: ee-ta-mee-mass ka? doh-koh ka yoo-bee-sa-shee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Put your glasses on.
target: 眼鏡をかけてください。
romanisation: meh-ga-nay oh ka-kay-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Cover your left eye.
target: 左目を隠してください。
romanisation: hee-da-ree-may oh ka-koo-shee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Cover your right eye.
target: 右目を隠してください。
romanisation: mee-ghee-may oh ka-koo-shee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Does your vision look like any of these? Point to the closest one.
target: どれに近いですか？一番近いものを指さしてください。
romanisation: doh-ray nee chee-kigh dess ka? ee-chee-ban chee-kigh moh-no oh yoo-bee-sa-shee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Please read the smallest line you can see.
target: 見える一番小さい行を読んでください。
romanisation: mee-eh-roo ee-chee-ban chee-sigh gyoh oh yon-day koo-da-sigh

english: Try to look through the tiny hole. It may make your vision clearer.
target: 小さな穴から見てください。よく見えるかもしれません。
romanisation: chee-sa-na ah-na ka-ra mee-tay koo-da-sigh. yoh-koo mee-eh-roo ka-moh shee-ray-ma-sen

english: How many fingers?
target: 指は何本ですか？
romanisation: yoo-bee wa nan-bon dess ka?

english: Can you see this?
target: これが見えますか？
romanisation: koh-ray ga mee-eh-mass ka?

english: Tell me if you see the light move.
target: 光が動いたら教えてください。
romanisation: hee-ka-ree ga oo-goy-ta-ra oh-shee-eh-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Look at my nose.
target: 私の鼻を見てください。
romanisation: wa-ta-shee no ha-na oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Do you see two of me?
target: 私が二人に見えますか？
romanisation: wa-ta-shee ga foo-ta-ree nee mee-eh-mass ka?

english: Is it worse looking this way?
target: こちらを見るとひどくなりますか？
romanisation: koh-chee-ra oh mee-roo toh hee-doh-koo na-ree-mass ka?

english: I am going to shine a light in your eyes. Please look at the wall behind me.
target: 目に光を当てます。私の後ろの壁を見てください。
romanisation: may nee hee-ka-ree oh ah-tay-mass. wa-ta-shee no oo-shee-roh no ka-bay oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Do not look at the light. Keep looking far away.
target: 光を見ないで、遠くを見ていてください。
romanisation: hee-ka-ree oh mee-nigh-day, toh-koo oh mee-tay ee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Keep both eyes open.
target: 両目を開けたままにしてください。
romanisation: ryoh-may oh ah-kay-ta ma-ma nee shee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Look at my finger. Do not move your head.
target: 私の指を見てください。頭は動かさないでください。
romanisation: wa-ta-shee no yoo-bee oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh. ah-ta-ma wa oo-goh-ka-sa-nigh-day koo-da-sigh

english: Look up.
target: 上を見てください。
romanisation: oo-eh oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Look down.
target: 下を見てください。
romanisation: shta oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Look left.
target: 左を見てください。
romanisation: hee-da-ree oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Look right.
target: 右を見てください。
romanisation: mee-ghee oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Look straight ahead.
target: まっすぐ前を見てください。
romanisation: mahs-soo-goo mah-eh oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: I am going to check the pressure in your eye.
target: 眼圧を測ります。
romanisation: gan-ats-oo oh ha-ka-ree-mass

english: This does not hurt. You will feel a light touch on your eye.
target: 痛くありません。目に軽く触れる感じがします。
romanisation: ee-ta-koo ah-ree-ma-sen. may nee ka-roo-koo foo-ray-roo kan-jee ga shee-mass

english: Please look straight ahead and hold still. Try not to blink.
target: まっすぐ前を見て、動かないでください。まばたきもしないでください。
romanisation: mahs-soo-goo mah-eh oh mee-tay, oo-goh-ka-nigh-day koo-da-sigh. ma-ba-ta-kee moh shee-nigh-day koo-da-sigh

english: Keep looking at my nose, not at my hand.
target: 私の鼻を見続けてください。手を見ないでください。
romanisation: wa-ta-shee no ha-na oh mee-tsoo-zoo-kay-tay koo-da-sigh. tay oh mee-nigh-day koo-da-sigh

english: Raise your hand when you see my fingers.
target: 指が見えたら手を上げてください。
romanisation: yoo-bee ga mee-eh-ta-ra tay oh ah-gay-tay koo-da-sigh

english: How many fingers do you see now?
target: 今、指は何本見えますか？
romanisation: ee-ma, yoo-bee wa nan-bon mee-eh-mass ka?

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
target: 薬のアレルギーはありますか？
romanisation: koo-soo-ree no ah-ray-roo-ghee wa ah-ree-mass ka?

english: I'm going to put drops in your eye.
target: 目薬をさします。
romanisation: meh-goo-soo-ree oh sa-shee-mass

english: Please look up.
target: 上を見てください。
romanisation: oo-eh oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: This is an analgesic for your eyes. It may sting for a few seconds.
target: 目の麻酔薬です。数秒しみることがあります。
romanisation: may no ma-soo-ee-ya-koo dess. soo-byoh shee-mee-roo koh-toh ga ah-ree-mass

english: This drop will dilate your pupils.
target: この目薬は瞳孔を広げます。
romanisation: koh-no meh-goo-soo-ree wa doh-koh oh hee-roh-gay-mass

english: Your vision will be blurry for about 6 hours.
target: 約6時間、見えにくくなります。
romanisation: ya-koo roh-koo-jee-kan, mee-eh-nee-koo-koo na-ree-mass

english: Please close your eyes.
target: 目を閉じてください。
romanisation: may oh toh-jee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Don't rub your eyes.
target: 目をこすらないでください。
romanisation: may oh koh-soo-ra-nigh-day koo-da-sigh

english: Chin on the rest, forehead against the bar.
target: 顎をここに乗せ、額をここにつけてください。
romanisation: ah-goh oh koh-koh nee no-say, hee-tigh oh koh-koh nee tsoo-kay-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Open your eyes wide.
target: 目を大きく開けてください。
romanisation: may oh oh-kee-koo ah-kay-tay koo-da-sigh

english: Don't pull your head back.
target: 頭を後ろに引かないでください。
romanisation: ah-ta-ma oh oo-shee-roh nee hee-ka-nigh-day koo-da-sigh

english: The light is bright. Please bear with it.
target: 光が眩しいです。少し我慢してください。
romanisation: hee-ka-ree ga ma-boo-shee dess. skoh-shee ga-man shtay koo-da-sigh

english: Look at my ear.
target: 私の耳を見てください。
romanisation: wa-ta-shee no mee-mee oh mee-tay koo-da-sigh

english: I'm going to touch your eyelid.
target: まぶたに触ります。
romanisation: ma-boo-ta nee sa-wa-ree-mass

english: Almost done.
target: もうすぐ終わります。
romanisation: moh-soo-goo oh-wa-ree-mass

english: The exam is finished. Thank you.
target: 診察は終わりです。ありがとうございました。
romanisation: shin-sa-tsu wa oh-wa-ree dess. ah-ree-ga-toh goh-zigh-ma-shta

english: We will use an interpreter to explain the results.
target: 結果は通訳を通して説明します。
romanisation: kek-ka wa tsoo-ya-koo oh toh-shtay set-soo-may shee-mass
